query: SELECT contaNumero, bancoNome, formaCobranca, COUNT(*) as cnt, SUM(CAST(valorLiquido AS DECIMAL(18,2)) - CAST(COALESCE(valorRecebidoLiquido, '0') AS DECIMAL(18,2))) as totalPendente FROM accounts_receivable WHERE estado = 'EMITIDO' AND contaNumero IS NOT NULL AND contaNumero != 'NULL' AND contaNumero != '' GROUP BY contaNumero, bancoNome, formaCobranca ORDER BY bancoNome, contaNumero;
